Huntail

Water

Hoenn · Generation 3

Huntail is a Water-type Deep Sea Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.7 m tall and weighs 27 kg. It evolves from Clamperl. Its highest base stat is Defense (105), with a base stat total of 485.
